The bigger picture behind a title

A web and iPhone/iPad dashboard for Netflix-style catalogue CSV data. Search and filters drive release-year, genre, country, and rating charts. The demo includes clearly labeled invented sample titles; importing a CSV keeps data on your device.

Project status
Both native iOS targets compile with Xcode, and their focused Swift analytics checks pass. Native simulator interaction testing remains unverified due to an SDK/runtime mismatch on the development machine. Neither app is on the App Store yet. The public web companions run independently of the native apps; Python ML forecasts require a deployed backend URL.
Stock forecasts are experimental, not investment advice. StreamLens is independent of Netflix and reports catalogue statistics, not viewing engagement.
